meta.title: Performance Optimization: Fix N+1 Query Patterns
meta.body_summary: Optimize 6 N+1 Prisma query patterns across TeamService, UserService, and GitProviderService by replacing chained queries with single include queries; claims 50-70% reduction in database query time.

perf_labels.notes: Devin optimized 6 N+1 Prisma query patterns across 3 service classes; no human review, CI passed but PR closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 227 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It targets a focused query optimization across 4 files but was closed without merge despite passing CI, indicating absent maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or CHANGES_REQUESTED feedback was recorded. Only a bot CI comment indicated passing e2e tests.
review_details.performance_claim: 50-70% reduction in database query time, lower connection pool pressure, and better scalability.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without any human review, merge, or explicit rejection comment; likely closed due to inactivity or lack of maintainer attention.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a technically sound query optimization (single commit with include pattern) but the PR received no human review and was eventually closed, illustrating a process gap where AI-authored PRs may be ignored or overlooked.

detection_detail.ci_auto: nx-cloud[bot] ran 'nx e2e amplication-server --prod' and reported success, but this validates correctness, not performance.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No concrete before/after measurements, benchmark, or profiler data were provided; the PR body and PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md contain only narrative performance claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge; no fix-in-PR cycle occurred as there was no review feedback to address.

core_change_summary.description: In TeamService, UserService, and GitProviderService, replaced chained Prisma relation access patterns (e.g., findUnique().members()) with a single query using include, plus null-safety fallback. A PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md was added with further analysis.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md contains an analysis of fixed patterns and future recommendations, not actual runtime measurements.
change_trajectory: Single commit (05a6d112d) applied the include optimizations to all 6 methods and added the performance report; no subsequent iterations.

review_signals.summary: Nx Cloud reported that 'nx e2e amplication-server --prod' succeeded in 1m 6s.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with a single commit and a comprehensive body.
Within 3 minutes, label 'app:amplication-server' added and nx-cloud bot reported CI success.
No human interaction occurred; PR later closed without merge (no closing event in timeline, closed_at missing).
